description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Collins Aerospace develops aerospace and defense solutions for civilian, military, and government customers. The Software Engineer I designs, develops, integrates, and verifies embedded software solutions, contributing to software implementation and testing for mission-focused products.
Software Engineer I designing, developing, integrating, and verifying embedded software solutions

Responsibilities:
• As a Software Engineer I on our team, you will play a key role in the design, development, integration, and verification of our embedded software solutions
• The ideal candidate will consistently deliver superior results, ensuring project milestones are met while fostering a positive work environment
• You should thrive in collaborative team settings, both in-person and through technology, and enjoy working closely with others to achieve shared goals
• You will also have opportunities to collaborate with experts across other disciplines, including hardware, systems, and FPGA engineering
• You will be a part of a team that is developing new and innovative products for our customers’ mission
• You will face and conquer challenges across a wide range of complex and interesting problem domains
• You will develop your skills with software application tools and languages such as Rust, C ++, and Python
• You will impact the team positively by demonstrating your ability to implement and test software solutions
• You will have opportunities to learn about cryptography, waveform & networking protocols, embedded devices, DevSecOps, command & control, project engineering

Requirements:
• The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued security clearance is required
• U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance
• Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and less than 2 years prior relevant experience

Preferred:
• Comfortable working with C, C++, Rust, python and/or Linux
• Some experience coding in an embedded environment
• Security focused mindset
• Familiar with multi-threaded and object oriented development
• Familiar with the basics of asymmetric and symmetric encryption
